name: Crispy Skin-On Chicken Wings (High-Fat Lipids WARNING)
whyItWorks: Chicken wings consist of over 60% skin and subcutaneous fat. Consuming 6–8 wings delivers 30+ grams of dense poultry grease that overwhelms impaired small bowel bile reabsorption, provoking rapid diarrhea and cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID skin-on wings. Choose skinless chicken tenderloins or breast skewers instead.
